# README visual

Rebuild from the repository root with Python 3.10+, Pillow 11+ and Arial/Menlo or DejaVu fonts:

```sh
python3 .github/assets/demo/render.py
```

`scenes.json` is the editable storyboard. This is an illustrated walkthrough of local examples. Local example outputs and reproduction commands are in `evidence.txt`. No production credentials or customer data are used.
